cases.purpose: Missing command searched through a private PATH
cases.oracle: GNU timeout in the locked disposable VM with the same private fixture and PATH.
cases.comparison: Exact status and output; diagnostic is checked for the failed command name.
cases.script: PATH="$PWD/bin"; export PATH; timeout 2 absent-command >out 2>err; rc=$?; [[ -s err && $(<err) == *absent-command* ]] && diagnostic=yes || diagnostic=no; [[ ! -s out ]] && empty=yes || empty=no; printf "status=%s diagnostic=%s empty=%s\n" "$rc" "$diagnostic" "$empty"; /bin/rm -f out err
cases.reference_script: PATH="$PWD/bin"; export PATH; /usr/bin/timeout 2 absent-command >out 2>err; rc=$?; [[ -s err && $(<err) == *absent-command* ]] && diagnostic=yes || diagnostic=no; [[ ! -s out ]] && empty=yes || empty=no; printf "status=%s diagnostic=%s empty=%s\n" "$rc" "$diagnostic" "$empty"; /bin/rm -f out err
